user_authorization: Sure, go ahead; then chose Equal game frames for the later training comparison.
matched_budget: Actual gameplay frames, with batch-boundary accounting tolerance declared before training. Report startup frames, policy decisions, optimizer steps and wall time separately.
training_seed_pairs: Match training stream seeds within each pair; freeze count and exact values before execution. D7/D8 and subsequent evaluation cohorts excluded.
primary_evaluation: Evaluate both trained policies with the same one-frame sampled controller on fresh shared normal-start games. Keep a four-frame evaluation secondary to separate training effects from inference timing.

temporal_discount_proposal.reason: Keep the same game-time discount and GAE decay despite different decisions per frame; requires separate pre-run acceptance.

open_before_launch: Freeze total gameplay-frame target and per-segment limits using actual one-frame training calibration.
Choose rollout and minibatch sizing to avoid unintended changes in optimizer-step frequency; report any unavoidable compute difference.
Validate incomplete-rollout bootstrap, true termination and final frame-budget handling.
Freeze evaluation cohort, seed exclusions, checkpoint-selection rule and primary analysis.
Complete source, actual-startup, independent review, registration, AC/resource and exact-once gates.
conditional_gate: Accepted D8 terminal audit and positive prespecified primary Q1 replication criterion. If failed, reconcile before training.
